contract.authority: P-003 audit proposals only. Do not change a feature/change row, plan item, claim, hold, link, fleet spec, or the master disposition ledger.
contract.recordRead: Read the complete frozen JSON file for every assigned ID. Use candidate-union group/reason/lineage fields and reviewed context IDs for comparisons. Programmatic batch extraction is encouraged; a bounded exception pass handles conflicts.
contract.default: Preservation is the default. Absence of a candidate signal is not proof of relevance, but after the complete record is checked and no explicit terminal/duplicate/supersession/implementation evidence exists, record preserve-no-candidate-signal.
contract.hardFloor: A hard floor, active assignment, hold, blocker, needs-human state, remote origin, unique evidence, uncertain survivor, or policy boundary prevents a mutation proposal unless the result records the exact stronger evidence and leaves P-004 a required check.
contract.candidate: Any candidate outcome must name evidence and requiredBeforeMutation. Duplicate/shared-root outcomes must name proposedCanonical and preserve stable producer identity, occurrence history, unique evidence, holds, and both reference directions under D-006.
contract.currentState: Frozen values are audit evidence, not mutation authority. P-004 re-reads current rows, full bodies, claims, origin, holds, code/plan/completion lineage, and both reference directions before any recoverable transition.
contract.forbidden: Do not read/poll the old bulk-run state. Do not restore fleet claim-spec revision 15. Do not perform cleanup.

evidence: specific frozen fields, group/lineage ids, plan/code/completion refs
entries.proposedCanonical: required for duplicate/shared-root consolidation candidates only
requiredBeforeMutation: at least one explicit P-004 check for every candidate outcome
